title: Phase Transitions in Learning Driven by Extremal Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.29531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study an extremal regression problem, an example of multiple instance learning (MIL), where the predictors are given as multisets, called bags. The bag elements (called instances) possess hidden labels which are pooled to produce an observed bag-level label. Max pooling is common in MIL applications, but gives rise to vanishing gradients. To handle this, modern MIL pipelines approximate the max with a softmax, treating the sharpness as a learnable parameter, denoted $\lambda$. When the max pooling model is the true data generating process, learning will be successful when $\lambda$ is increased during gradient descent, thereby driving the dynamics into regions of parameter space with vanishing gradients. translated_title: 由极值数据驱动的学习相变
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个极值回归问题，它是多示例学习（MIL）的一个实例，其中预测器以多重集的形式给出，称为“袋”（bag）。袋中的元素（称为“示例”，instance）具有隐藏标签，这些标签被池化以产生观测到的袋级标签。最大池化在MIL应用中很常见，但会导致梯度消失。为了解决这一问题，现代MIL流程采用softmax来近似最大值，并将锐度视为可学习参数，记为 $\lambda$。当最大池化模型是真实的数据生成过程时，学习会在梯度下降过程中增大 $\lambda$ 时取得成功，从而将动力学驱动到参数空间中梯度消失的区域。为了理解梯度下降在什么条件下会失效，我们研究了一个极简模型，并在袋大小 $n$ 与维度 $d$ 都很大的联合极限下（$\alpha=\ln...$），推导出了梯度流的低维投影。
tldr: 该论文通过研究多示例学习中的极值回归问题，推导出梯度流的低维投影，揭示了当softmax近似最大池化的锐度参数 $\lambda$ 增大使动力学进入梯度消失区域时，学习会发生相变，从而刻画了梯度下降成功与失效的条件。
en_tdlr: By analyzing extremal regression in multiple instance learning, the paper derives a low-dimensional projection of gradient flow that reveals phase transitions occurring as the softmax sharpness parameter grows, characterizing when gradient descent succeeds or breaks down due to vanishing gradients.
